topics.title: Circuit Analysis
topics.description: Systematic methods for analyzing electrical circuits — node voltage and mesh current methods.
objectives: Apply the node voltage method
Apply the mesh current method
Use superposition and source transformation
Apply Thevenin and Norton equivalent circuits

topics.title: AC Circuits
topics.description: Analysis of circuits with sinusoidal sources using phasors and impedance.
objectives: Represent sinusoidal signals with phasors
Define impedance for resistors, inductors, and capacitors
Analyze AC circuits in the frequency domain
Compute power in AC circuits

topics.title: Operational Amplifiers
topics.description: The ideal op-amp model and common configurations — inverting, non-inverting, summing, integrator.
objectives: Apply the ideal op-amp rules
Analyze inverting and non-inverting amplifier circuits
Design summing amplifiers and integrators
Understand feedback and stability qualitatively

topics.title: Digital Logic
topics.description: Boolean algebra, logic gates, combinational and sequential logic circuits.
objectives: Apply Boolean algebra and De Morgan's theorems
Design and simplify combinational logic circuits
Build flip-flops and sequential logic
Understand binary number representation

topics.title: Signal Processing
topics.description: Fourier analysis, filtering, and the frequency-domain view of signals.
objectives: Compute Fourier series for periodic signals
Apply the Fourier transform and understand its properties
Design simple low-pass and high-pass filters
Introduce discrete-time signals and the DFT
